# Inert synthetic fixtures

These files were authored for this prototype; they are not downloaded malware or original incident samples. `SKILL.md.fixture` is never discoverable as a Codex skill. The test and demonstration harnesses materialize it as `SKILL.md` only beneath `os.tmpdir()`.

The portfolio scenario uses fictitious DEMOUSD and demo account identifiers. The JSON action plan drives a deterministic replay and is not an observation of any model's behavior. Source evidence and evaluation labels live outside the files supplied to the scanner.
